messages:
Alex R: Hey — first day! Quick Q: I can view the Notion onboarding pages but not edit. Where do we keep the official templates and what's the process to get edit access?
Morgan L: welcome Alex :tada: Templates live in the Docs Hub under 'Onboarding & Templates'. Path: Redwood HQ → Docs Hub → Onboarding → Templates.
Alex R: thanks — I can see that folder but all pages say 'Can view'. Tried 'Request access' and it says needs admin approval.
Samira P: @Alex R for immediate edits you can duplicate a template to your private workspace, but for team-owned pages we need to add you to the 'Docs Editors' group. Morgan or Taylor can add you.
Taylor (IT): Hey Alex — we manage SSO groups. Please fill this short form so we can add you to Docs Editors: https://forms.redwood.internal/it-access (put your email and the requested Notion workspace). Once IT confirms, Morgan will upgrade the page permissions.
DevEx Bot: Hi! If you're following the onboarding checklist, step 3 is 'Request Notion edit access'. DevEx will ping Morgan after IT confirms.
Morgan L: I'm on it. Alex can you paste your work email here? Also include which pages you need write access to (specific PRDs, runbooks, or onboarding templates).
Alex R: alex.redwood@example.com. Main ones: Onboarding Checklist, SWE Team Handbook, and Product PRD template.
Morgan L: got it. I'll request group add after Taylor confirms. Meanwhile if you need to spin up a personal copy: open the template → ••• → Duplicate into your workspace. For copying structure we prefer using the 'Duplicate with subpages' option.
Samira P: Note on naming conventions: team onboarding pages should start with "[Team] — Title" (e.g., "[SWE] — First Week Checklist"). Helps search and permissions.
Taylor (IT): Confirmed — entered the request with Notion SSO team. ETA ~30–90 mins.
Alex R: awesome, thanks everyone. Quick follow-up: are there canonical examples for a first-week checklist?
Morgan L: Yep — see Templates → Onboarding → "New Hire — First Week (Engineering)". Copy that and replace the redwood-specific tasks. If you want I can share a brief starter draft for your team.
Alex R: that would be great, appreciate it.
Morgan L: I'll drop a short copy in your workspace and tag you when done. :thumbsup:
Alex R: perfect — thanks again!
Samira P: also ping #eng if you need any repo access after Notion is sorted.
Alex R: will do.
